cvEn:
Zmira (Mori) Rishti, daughter of Lalua and David, was born on the 20th of Tevet 5705 (5 January 1945) in Baghdad, the capital of Iraq. After all the family members had immigrated to Israel, Zmira began her studies at an elementary school in Ramat Gan, and afterwards attended the "Devir" high school there, from which she graduated.

When the time came, she was drafted into the IDF in September 1962. A year later, on the 13th of Tishri 5724 (30 September 1963), she fell while carrying out her duties, and was laid to rest in the military cemetery at Kiryat Shaul.
